scripts.build: npm run build -w @contract-kit/kernel && npm run build -w @contract-kit/docx && npm run build -w @contract-kit/xlsx && npm run build -w @contract-kit/ui && npm run build -w @contract-kit/pdf && npm run build -w contract-kit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @contract-kit/kernel && npm run typecheck -w @contract-kit/kernel && npm run typecheck -w @contract-kit/docx && npm run typecheck -w @contract-kit/xlsx && npm run typecheck -w @contract-kit/ui && npm run typecheck -w @contract-kit/pdf && npm run typecheck -w contract-kit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test packages/kernel/test/*.test.ts packages/docx/test/*.test.ts packages/xlsx/test/*.test.ts packages/ui/test/*.test.ts
